name: Termwise
title: A tidy semester desk
description: A student semester desk: extract syllabi, confirm or edit the table, catch 48-hour pileups, keep optional work-back study blocks, draft extensions, and send a Sunday brief. Connect Google Calendar / Gmail, Outlook Calendar / Outlook mail, or Apple Calendar — you pick, you do not inherit logins — or use Fallback: .ics download / mailto draft. Never writes calendar or mail without a preview.
